sentences.text: Joel David Coen -LRB- born November 29 , 1954 -RRB- and Ethan Jesse Coen -LRB- born September 21 , 1957 -RRB- , collectively referred to as the Coen brothers , are American filmmakers .	filmmakers	filmmakers
Their films span many genres and styles , which they frequently subvert or parody .

Their best-reviewed works include Fargo -LRB- 1996 -RRB- , The Big Lebowski -LRB- 1998 -RRB- , No Country for Old Men -LRB- 2007 -RRB- , A Serious Man -LRB- 2009 -RRB- , True Grit -LRB- 2010 -RRB- , and Inside Llewyn Davis -LRB- 2013 -RRB- .	Fargo	Fargo (film)	The Big Lebowski	The Big Lebowski	No Country for Old Men	No Country for Old Men (film)	A Serious Man	A Serious Man	True Grit	True Grit (2010 film)	Inside Llewyn Davis	Inside Llewyn Davis

The brothers write , direct and produce their films jointly , although until The Ladykillers -LRB- 2004 -RRB- Joel received sole credit for directing and Ethan for producing .	The Ladykillers	The Ladykillers (2004 film)
They often alternate top billing for their screenplays while sharing editing credits under the alias Roderick Jaynes .	top billing	Billing (filmmaking)	alias	Pseudonym

They have been nominated for thirteen Academy Awards together , and individually for one award each , winning Best Original Screenplay for Fargo and Best Picture , Best Director and Best Adapted Screenplay for No Country for Old Men .	Fargo	Fargo (film)	No Country for Old Men	No Country for Old Men (film)	Best Original Screenplay	Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay	Best Picture	Academy Award for Best Picture	Best Director	Academy Award for Best Director	Best Adapted Screenplay	Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay
The duo also won the Palme d'Or for Barton Fink and were nominated for Fargo .	Fargo	Fargo (film)	Palme d'Or	Palme d'Or	Barton Fink	Barton Fink

The Coen brothers have written a number of films they did not direct , including the biographical war drama Unbroken -LRB- 2014 -RRB- , the historical legal thriller Bridge of Spies -LRB- 2015 -RRB- , and lesser-known , commercially unsuccessful comedies such as Crimewave -LRB- 1985 -RRB- , The Naked Man -LRB- 1998 -RRB- and Gambit -LRB- 2012 -RRB- . Ethan is also a writer of short stories , theater and poetry .

The brothers 's films No Country for Old Men , A Serious Man and Inside Llewyn Davis have been ranked in the BBC 's 2016 poll of the greatest motion pictures since 2000 .
